scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Failure of rational injectivity for maximal coarse assembly” (preprints/Failure-of-rational-injectivity-for-maximal-coarse-assembly-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 307 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 30556c04280bf987), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist finite connected graphs (Xj)j≥1 with a common finite bound on vertex degree, a coarse disjoint union X = F j≥1 Xj, and an infinite-order class α ∈ KX1(X) such that µmax X (α) = 0. Consequently, µmax X ⊗ Q is not injective.
